{{Top|leg}}
A '''Spy satellite''' was a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] equipped with surveillance equipment such as [[Electrotelescope/Legends|Electrotelescopes]] and sensor ablative coatings such as [[Reflec/Legends|Reflec]].

The imperial research station [[Epsilon Nine]] was charged with researching and developing new spy satellites for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].

Shortly after the mission to [[Storinal]], [[Wraith Squadron]] deployed several spy satellite's in the [[Todirium system/Legends|Todirium system]].
